subject: Availability carveout request — HelpTech / required uptime & latency
messages:
From: Isabel Martin <isabel@helptech.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: helptech-sales@helptech.com
Date: 2027-06-18T09:32:00Z
Subject: Request: availability carveout for HelpTech contract

Hi Monica,

Quick note following our demo — HelpTech is moving toward a pilot with our fraud detection pipeline and security/compliance is a hard requirement for the deal team. They asked whether Redwood can commit to a higher availability/latency SLA than standard for a 12-month initial term. Specifically they want: 

- 99.99% uptime (annual)
- p95 latency <= 50ms for inference requests (typical payloads)

Can you confirm if Redwood will consider an exception and what the procurement path looks like (timeline, any additional requirements, contract language, and pricing uplift)? We're on a tight timeline — procurement asks for a draft commitment this week to move to legal redlines.

I've attached the RFP excerpt that calls this out. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Isabel Martin
Head of Platform Partnerships
HelpTech Inc.

Attachment: HelpTech_RFP.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-18T10:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: availability carveout for HelpTech contract

Team — forwarding Isabel's ask. Short summary and asks below.

Summary:
- Customer: HelpTech (enterprise prospect, security-first)
- Ask: 99.99% uptime + p95 <= 50ms for inference for 12 months
- Timing: procurement wants a draft commitment this week

Immediate asks: 
1) Product (Karthik) — is 99.99% / 50ms p95 feasible on hosted Redwood catalog models? If not, what are the required constraints (dedicated capacity, reserved nodes, quantization limits, sequence length caps)? Please list the minimum configuration and runbook we'll require for the commitment.
2) Ops/Platform (Lauren) — what operational changes and monitoring/tracing commitments are needed? Will this require a dedicated pool and a 3x headroom? Any required changes to our incident response SLA?
3) Sales (Aditya) — if technically feasible, can we offer a provisional carveout while legal finalizes contract language? Need guidance on pricing uplift estimate and whether we must require Dedicated or Private deployment to give the commitment.

I attached a quick spreadsheet I started with basic assumptions. I can pull legal in once we have the product/ops conditions.

Thanks — could each of you reply with a short note by EOD today? Customer is sensitive to timeline.

—Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: initial-assessment.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-19T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: availability carveout for HelpTech contract

Monica — thanks for the summary. High-level feasibility notes below; see attached short doc for details.

Feasibility (TL;DR): Possible with conditions. Not safe on standard hosted pool.

Conditions to offer 99.99% / 50ms p95:
- Dedicated capacity: customer must provision a reserved pool (Dedicated) with pinned nodes. Shared pools have variable tail latency.
- Resource headroom: recommend 3x nominal capacity for peak concurrency to avoid queuing-induced p95 spikes; autoscale policies must be disabled for the reserved pool and we will manage scale per the runbook.
- Model selection/quantization: commit to specific model variant (e.g., redwood-v2-7b-q4f) that has validated p95 under expected payloads. No model upgrades without 30-day notice and joint performance testing.
- Traffic shaping & limits: enforce per-tenant concurrency limits and circuit-breaker policy.
- Observability: full tracing + per-request availability logs retained for 90 days; customer must provide an SLO contact and authorize access for joint post-incident reviews.
- Incident SLAs: 15-minute response for P0, with 2-hour mitigation window for availability incidents; full remediation timelines depend on root cause but will be captured in runbook.

Open items: liability cap increase? legal needs to review. Also need product/infra sign-off on test harness for 50ms p95 metrics.

If Ops + Sales agree, we can provisionally sign off on a conditional carveout to present to the customer (language: "Availability commitment provided subject to reserved capacity and operational runbook"). Also attaching a short feasibility note and measurement plan.

—Karthik Iyer
VP, Product — Serving Runtime

Attachment: availability-feasibility-notes.md

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Isabel Martin <isabel@helptech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-21T13:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: availability carveout for HelpTech contract

Hi Isabel — thanks for the clarity and the RFP excerpt. 

We can offer a provisional availability carveout to help move the procurement process while legal finalizes contract language. High-level commitments and next steps: 

- Provisional commitment: 99.99% uptime (annual) and p95 inference latency target of <= 50ms, provided the customer accepts the following conditions: 
  * Dedicated / reserved capacity (Redwood Dedicated) with node sizing as per our runbook
  * 3x headroom provisioning for peak concurrency
  * Fixed model variant for the term with joint performance verification before go-live
  * Per-request tracing and 90-day availability logs for joint review
  * Incident response of 15-minute acknowledgement for P0s and a 2-hour mitigation objective

- Commercials & next steps: Aditya will follow up with pricing uplift and procurement language. Legal will provide required contract changes (liability cap, credits) for review. Lauren will coordinate the operational runbook and a go/no-go test window.

We will circulate a redlined draft to your procurement and legal teams by EOD Thursday (2027-06-24). Can you confirm whether HelpTech can accept Dedicated deployment and the 90-day log-sharing requirement? If helpful, we can set a 30-minute operational sync tomorrow.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[This message summarizes internal agreement and a provisional external commitment; final contract will depend on legal and infra approvals.]
